# B2 vocabulary batch 104

Added 25 manually authored B2 entries: `offhand`, `offshore`, `ointment`, `olympiad`, `openly`,
`optimist`, `orator`, `orchestral`, `orchid`, `organiser`, `originality`, `originate`, `ounce`,
`outback`, `outdistance`, `outdo`, `outgrow`, `outing`, `outlive`, `outpatient`, `outrage`,
`outrageous`, `outshine`, `outsider`, and `overboard`.

Each row was checked for meaning, part of speech, IPA, level, controlled topics, and original
English/Vietnamese examples. The proper-name candidate `Olympia` was not promoted; the useful
common noun `olympiad` was added instead.
